# ruststream-rust-mqtt

> `ruststream-rust-mqtt` is the MQTT 5 broker crate for RustStream, a Rust framework for services that subscribe to message brokers and publish to them. It is built on the `rust-mqtt` client and targets the embassy and compio runtimes of RustStream.

This site holds the guides, one page per component and the architecture of the crate; the API reference is on docs.rs, and the framework itself is documented on the RustStream site.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-rust-mqtt/latest/): what the crate is

## Components

- [Components](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-rust-mqtt/latest/components/): the parts of the crate an MQTT service uses, one page each

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-rust-mqtt/latest/architecture/): where the crate sits between the MQTT broker and the RustStream runtime

## Reference

- [API reference](https://docs.rs/ruststream-rust-mqtt): the crate's rustdoc
- [RustStream](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream/latest/): the framework
